source: OEB regulated ULO + Alectra (Horizon/Hamilton zone) residential delivery, alectrautilities.com/rates-service-charges
period_rules_comment: Evaluated in order: overnight (23:00-07:00 daily) > weekend_offpeak (weekends/holidays 07:00-23:00) > onpeak (weekdays 16:00-21:00) > midpeak (weekdays otherwise)
holidays_comment: Ontario statutory holidays (OEB schedule); computed in daemon
notes: ULO energy rates are identical summer/winter and apply province-wide. Delivery fixed charges are unavoidable monthly costs (not caused by EV charging); only the variable delivery + line-loss scale with charging kWh.
